updated.description: The editions whose database file was replaced; can be filled even when ok is false

error.description: Why the update failed; only when ok is false

description:
Downloads the selected GeoLite2 databases from MaxMind now and waits for the result, which can take a while. A failure answers 200 with ok false and the reason in error; updated can still list editions that were replaced.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
